purpose: Supplemental standard TestClock/State/List.map and suspending List.fold source observation. Original source body, C harness and resource limits are reused except the explicitly recorded frame size.
pipeline: official frontend -> raw Flow -> adapter -> BackendInput -> saved JSON replay -> identical C artifacts -> strict O0/O2 C execution

budget_difference.measurement: Host C sizeof(emela_fn_24_frame); 1024 fails generated static assertion,2048 passes. This is a source-lowering frame-layout difference, not a claim of the old memory budget.

observations: All public clock entries retain suspension semantics, including immediate now().
SystemClock reads1000, waits one task for42ms, then observes42 elapsed.
TestClock holds State[Instant], clamps -7 sleep to0 and advances virtual time100→150 through two explicit when_stalled completions.
List.map invokes a suspending callback; upstream standard List.fold produces actual suspend Break/Block/ListIsEmpty/ListHead/ListTail Flow.
Duplicate and stale task notifications are rejected, results remain unwritten before resumption, and every released root reclaims all heap blocks over1000 rounds.
scope_note: TestClock contains Tag inside a synchronous State.update closure. This report does not claim direct Tag-suspend evidence; that context is covered by the separate raised-interruption source fixture.

frame_layout_audit.host: 64-bit host C11, sizeof measured from generated C; fields summed separately
frame_layout_audit.function: emela_fn_24, the State.run callback containing the three virtual-time assertions
frame_layout_audit.primary_cause: Official raw Flow expands equality assertions into failing-branch Int64.to_string/Show and String.append diagnostics containing both operand values. The previous independent frontend generated only the constant16-byte message assertion failed; its largest measured same-fixture frame was296bytes and had no diagnostic scratch arrays.
frame_layout_audit.layout_policy: The reused suspend emitter places every active local, ownership flag and planned String buffer into the frame (src/backend/emit/suspend.rs). It does not separate non-suspending temporary diagnostic storage or overlay mutually exclusive failure branches. Scratch990bytes and String views360bytes dominate this conservative layout.
frame_layout_audit.lifetime_review: All15 diagnostic values are initialized only inside the three assertion-failure branches; the successful suspension/resumption path does not acquire these owners. Existing1000-round heap-empty assertions pass. No unexpected capture, retained live owner or field-layout corruption was found. Reserving failure-only storage for the frame duration is conservative allocation and an optimization opportunity, not evidence that1624 is the minimal possible frame.
frame_layout_audit.conclusion: Keep the1024 failure and the explicit2048 verification separate. The difference is explained by richer official assertion lowering combined with inherited frame allocation policy; no production code change was made.
